name: aplyx-workspace
description: aplyx monorepo root — npm workspaces for the shared TS core, the Ink TUI, and the Tauri desktop app.

scripts.build:app: npm run build:core && npm run build --workspace=@keshm/aplyx
scripts.typecheck:app: npm run build:core && npm run typecheck --workspace=@keshm/aplyx
scripts.smoke:app: npm run build:app && npm run smoke --workspace=@keshm/aplyx
